raw_html: [[Bane (enchantment)|Lesser Goblinoid Bane]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Bane (enchantment)|Lesser Goblinoid Bane]]:''' A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Goblinoids, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +1 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 1 to 6 points of damage against the foe.
